name: Meta Muse Code
description: Meta's terminal-based AI coding agent released in beta, powered by Muse Spark 1.2 model. Handles complex software engineering tasks across large repositories including planning changes, writing code, and validating results. Features async background agents, local event log for crash recovery, commands like /plan, /grill, and /goal, and multi-agent coordination.

name: Sinch Agent Tools
description: A suite of developer integrations for building with Sinch's communication platform directly within IDEs and AI coding tools. Includes IDE extensions for VS Code and JetBrains, simulator mode for testing without account setup, and MCP server compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and ChatGPT Desktop.
